insights.summary: Q2 FY27 was a record: revenue ₹1,323 Cr (up 336% year on year, 61% on the quarter), operating EBITDA ₹197 Cr at 14.9% and PAT ₹137 Cr. AI systems were 58% of revenue. A ₹1,200 Cr QIP made the company net cash. Order book is ₹2,629 Cr plus ₹653 Cr of L1 positions, a little higher than last quarter despite record billing. Management gave no revenue guidance and repeated that its EBITDA framework is 13-14%.

what_changed.text: EBITDA margin framework 13-14%, with a warning that H1's 15.1% is not to be annualised
₹1,200 Cr QIP raised in the quarter; net cash of ₹14 Cr
Wholly owned R&D subsidiary in Taiwan approved
Vera Rubin systems to be offered for sale from January 2027
Cash conversion cycle expected between 90 and 110 days

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Q2 financial year '27 has been another record-breaking quarter for Netweb Technologies

analyst_questions.answer: Gross margin moves with deal mix and large-deal profile; the company guides on EBITDA, which stays around 14%.
Top-5 and top-10 customers keep changing; 449 new customers were added in H1.
Management prefers to hold EBITDA at the framework level and reinvest in R&D rather than show higher margins.
Yotta, E2E and others are customers in the pipeline; no order numbers disclosed.

red_flags.text: Gross margin has fallen as component prices rose; management would not give a steady-state level.
Inventory of about ₹1,900 Cr (117 days) is large relative to a ₹2,629 Cr order book.
Pipeline is ₹11,152 Cr but only ₹2,629 Cr is firm; orders are lumpy and a few customers drive revenue.
No revenue guidance, so next-quarter numbers rest on order book and past conversion.

watch_next: Q3 revenue versus the ₹2,629 Cr order book plus new orders
Operating EBITDA margin staying within or just above 13-14%
Use of the remaining ₹403 Cr of QIP money
NSM 2.0 orders from early 2027 and Vera Rubin launch in January
